findings.title: IPPool start/end range allocates subnet gateway; CIDR path reserves it
related_github: PR #8531 (ExternalIPPool CIDR gateway fix — partial overlap)
findings.expected_behavior: Gateway IP from IPPool.spec.subnetInfo is not assignable to workloads; docs/antrea-ipam.md treats gateway as non-allocatable for start/end ranges.
findings.actual_behavior: First AllocateNext from a start/end range can return the gateway address (e.g. 10.2.2.1 when gateway is 10.2.2.1 and range includes it).
findings.root_cause: CIDR branch passes reservedIPs including gateway; start/end branch calls NewIPRangeAllocator without reserving subnetInfo.gateway.
findings.user_impact: Pod receives default gateway as its address → broken routing, duplicate IP risk, inconsistent with CIDR-based pools on same cluster.

regression_test.name: TestAllocateNextSkipsGatewayInIPRange
regression_test.output_excerpt: expected gateway 10.2.2.2 (test used range where first allocatable after bug is .2); actual 10.2.2.1 — Messages: gateway must not be allocated from an IP range

findings.suggested_fix: Reserve gateway (and broadcast when applicable) for start/end ranges mirroring CIDR init, or reject ranges that include gateway.

findings.title: SecondaryNetworkAllocate assigns multiple IPv4 addresses from multiple IPv4 pools
related_github: Issue #7722 (secondary IPv6 feature — not this bug)
findings.expected_behavior: At most one IPv4 and one IPv6 per secondary interface, matching primary Add() and multiv4-1 test expectations.
findings.actual_behavior: Loop allocates from every pool in ipamConf.IPPools; sets allocatedIPv4 but never continues to skip further IPv4 pools.
findings.root_cause: Missing `if allocatedIPv4 { continue }` / `if allocatedIPv6 { continue }` and break when both families satisfied.
findings.user_impact: Secondary NAD listing two IPv4 pools can attach two IPv4s to one interface — ambiguous L3 config, extra IPPool consumption, possible policy/route confusion.

regression_test.name: TestSecondaryNetworkAllocateAtMostOneIPPerFamily
regression_test.output_excerpt: Two IPv4 addresses returned from multiv4-pool-a and multiv4-pool-b

findings.suggested_fix: Mirror Add() loop control flow; add table test analogous to multiv4-1 for SecondaryNetworkAllocate.
